We will analyze Coctails' data from GitHub.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```


# Read the data
```{r}
cocktails <- read_tsv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nthun/cocktail-balance/refs/heads/master/cocktail_data.tsv')
```

# Explore the data
```{r}
glimpse(cocktails)
skim(cocktails)
```

# Transform the data table and clean the ingredient variable
```{r}
cocktails_long <- cocktails %>%
  separate_rows(ingredients, sep = "<br/>")
```

```{r}
glimpse(cocktails)
```

```{r}
cocktails_long <- cocktails %>%
  separate_rows(ingredients, sep = "<br/>") %>%
  mutate(ingredients = str_remove(ingredients, "\\(.*\\)"),
         ingredients = str_remove(ingredients, "^[0-9/. ]+"),
         ingredients = str_remove(ingredients, "^(oz|ozs|dash|dashes|drop|drops|tsp|tbsp|barspoon|barspoons) "),
         ingredients = str_squish(ingredients))
```

```{r}
cocktails_long %>% count(ingredients, sort = TRUE)
```

# All ingredients in alphabetical order
```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  distinct(ingredients) %>%
  arrange(ingredients) %>%
  pull(ingredients)
```

# Number of unique ingredients
```{r}
n_distinct(cocktails_long$ingredients)
```

# What are the top 10 ingredients?
```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  count(ingredients, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10, with_ties = TRUE)
```

# Which cocktail(s) has/have the most ingredients?
```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  count(name, name = "n_ingredients") %>%
  filter(n_ingredients == max(n_ingredients))
```

# How many ingredients appear in only one cocktail (rare ingredient)?
```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  count(ingredients) %>%
  filter(n == 1) %>%
  nrow()
```

# Which cocktail has an ingredient that is only used in one cocktail?

```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  add_count(ingredients, name = "n_cocktails") %>%
  filter(n_cocktails == 1) %>%
  distinct(name)
```

# What are the cocktails without rare ingredients?

```{r}
cocktails_long %>%
  add_count(ingredients, name = "n_cocktails") %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  filter(all(n_cocktails > 1)) %>%
  distinct(name)
```

# Create a cheat sheet for the bartender!
```{r}
cocktail_matrix <- cocktails_long %>%
  distinct(name, ingredients) %>%
  mutate(value = "X") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ingredients,
              values_from = value,
              values_fill = "") %>%
  relocate(name, sort(names(.)))

cocktail_matrix
```
